Name: Faceless Free Cactuses
Author: Flor3nce2456
Description:
Removes the faces from the Desert Festival Free Cactuses so they are less Creepy and Easier to decorate with. For Content Patcher.

The Faces always bugged me, and nobody made a mod getting rid of them since the Desert Festival was introduced, so I decided to fix that myself.

No significant changes made to the Pots or Cactus tops, only the Cactus middle portions with the Faces have been changed to not have faces anymore.
[b]Not compatible with any Recolors[/b], let me know if there is a recolor you use that you want de-faced, and I'll reach out.

The photo should offer a decent preview, but if you would like to see more, the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner Mod[/url] can spawn random Free Cactuses for you to see, as many as you have space for.
